title: check_change_approval input
description: Answers the check step's question: does this change have the approvals its policy requires? Give exactly one of deploymentTargetId and targetExternalId. A read: it logs the question and the answer to a Gate Check row (L05) and changes nothing else. Release Later.
$comment: Release Later, after the gate decision (D-03). The pipeline acts on the answer at Advise or Enforce. The product never stops anything itself.

deploymentTargetId.description: The target by its row ID.

targetExternalId.description: The target's ID in its own tool.

artifactName.description: The artifact about to be deployed.

plannedStart.description: When the deployment is about to start. Leave out for now.

codeApprovalKind.description: Who approved the code merge, as reported. Evidence only.

emergency.description: True when the sender asks for the emergency path.

idempotencyKey.description: The sender's retry key for the Gate Check row. The server makes one when it is left out.
